description: Validate pasted JSON-LD against the schema.org vocabulary (every type, property, domain, range and enumeration value) and Google's documented rules for LocalBusiness and Organization markup: required name and address, recommended properties, hh:mm:ss hours, 5 decimal coordinates, priceRange length, self-serving reviews, sameAs. Accepts one block, several blocks, or the script tags around them. Each issue cites its source. No network access.

json_ld.description: JSON-LD text. Script tags are stripped; several script blocks are each validated.

name: validate_structured_data
title: Validate structured data
